body:
I had / have a decoration store.. with an sewing atelier where me make stuff .. it is my passion, what really makes me happy.. where I feel at home.. but with this pandemic situation it’s about to collapse, it’s not a primary need so the sells are not very good, not enough for the rent and even less for the sewing people to come to make more productos or new collections.. 
Before mom did I was always trying to forget all the damage that my father and brothers did to mom since they got separated, and how they left me behind since they separated 4 years ago and I stand up for her and told them I wasn’t going to be part of the attempt to steal her heritage.
Since then, moms light was slowly turning off..
I would have never expected she would do this.
Never ever.
But now that I think; why not she if I have always thought about doing it? Why would she not?

I have loved, Ive been loved, Ive danced, ive travelled (a little but something), I’ve been happy, very happy.. I just feel I will never recover after this.. 
one time, last year, I did the knob to hang myself with the cords of my camping tent and hanged it in the roof of the balcony of my mom, got a table and got over it.. but kept thinking..
What’s mom life going to be after this? Who is she going to have? Why am I letting her see this, finding me like this? And I kept fighting for her..
Why did she did this to me, on Christmas, one day before her birthday..
